title: Posting and availability of bicycle access plan or letter of exception.
officialText:
Bicycle access plans shall be posted and made available as provided in sections 28-504.1.4.1 through 28-504.1.4.3.

(Am. L.L. 2016/105, 9/28/2016, eff. 9/28/2016; Am. L.L. 2016/107, 9/28/2016, eff. 9/28/2016)
